summary: A light #f4f4f5 canvas with a faint grey dot grid (~22 px pitch). Top-left: a small tracked uppercase grey label "PEEL STICKER" (x 23, y 36) over a large semibold title "3 Prism", where the numeral is light grey and the word near-black. Top-right: a monospace grey caption "Your picture · WebGL 2" (right edge ~1235, y 92). In the centre sits one die-cut vinyl sticker, about 600x612 px at [332,252]: a black outlined X logo (white inner diagonal) with a ~22 px white die-cut border that follows the glyph with rounded corners, and a soft grey drop shadow below and to the right. Under it a centred light-grey hint, "Drag an edge to peel · move over it for the shine" (y 954), and a white pill segmented control at the bottom [335,1005,588,56] with five items, "1 White", "2 Sparkle", "3 Prism", "4 Ripple", "5 Halftone". The active item is a near-black pill with white text, and the numerals are grey. Motion: from 0 to 1.5s the Prism material shows a chromatic fringe (red, yellow, blue, cyan offset copies of the black strokes, a few px apart) that shifts with the cursor. From about 1.6s the sticker is dragged off by an edge. It curls back in 3D and shows a light-grey backing tiled with diagonal grey "MetalForge" text, the curl casts a soft shadow, and by 2.5s it is almost entirely pulled off toward the bottom-right. It springs back flat by about 3.2s, with only a small corner curl at top-left. More peels follow from the top-right (4.55s), the top-left and bottom-left (4.9 to 5.5s) and the bottom-right (6.1s), and each springs back to flat. At about 9.7s the picture is swapped for a full-colour Google "G" sticker in the same box. At about 10.5s "4 Ripple" is selected: concentric refractive ripples bend the blue panel and the red arm around the cursor. At about 11.3s "5 Halftone" is selected: the region near the cursor turns into a grid of round colour dots. From 14 to 16.2s the G is peeled the same way, then it settles flat until the end.

criteria.check: Background is a very light cool grey (~#f4f4f5), not pure white
A faint grid of small grey dots (~22 px pitch) covers the background, visible near the top-left corner
Top-left reads 'PEEL STICKER' in small uppercase letter-spaced mid-grey type
Under the label, a large title reads '3 Prism' (~32 px, semibold)
In the title the numeral '3' is light grey and the word 'Prism' is near-black
Top-right reads 'Your picture · WebGL 2' in light-grey monospace type, right-aligned near x 1235, y ~92
The sticker sits centred horizontally, spanning about x 332-932 and y 252-864
The sticker art is an X logo: two black diagonal strokes where the top-left-to-bottom-right stroke is an outlined bar with a white interior
A solid white die-cut border about 20-24 px wide follows the X outline with rounded outer corners and rounded inner notches
The sticker casts a soft blurred grey shadow, strongest along the bottom and right edges, with no hard outline
At rest under the cursor, the black strokes carry thin coloured fringes (red, yellow, blue, cyan) offset a few px along their edges
The prism effect shows as discrete offset coloured copies of the edges (a split-channel look), not as a smooth rainbow gradient fill over the sticker
The fringe colours move with the cursor: between the two moments the red/yellow bands along the top-left stroke change width and position
When the cursor is near the top-right arm, the strongest cyan/blue/red/yellow fringe sits on that arm's right edge (x ~780-890, y ~275-420)
Below the sticker, centred, reads 'Drag an edge to peel · move over it for the shine' in light-grey ~16 px type
A white rounded pill control is centred at the bottom (about x 335-923, y 1005-1061)
The control lists exactly five items in order: '1 White', '2 Sparkle', '3 Prism', '4 Ripple', '5 Halftone'
In each item the numeral is grey and the word is near-black
The active item '3 Prism' sits on a near-black fully rounded pill with white text
The sticker is being peeled: most of the top-left arm and the centre are lifted and curled, leaving only the top-right arm, the bottom-left arm and the bottom-right corner flat
The underside of the curled sticker is light grey and tiled with repeated grey 'MetalForge' wordmarks set at an angle
The curled flap reads as bent paper/vinyl: shading varies across the roll and the wordmarks distort with the curve, instead of a flat grey shape
The lifted flap casts a soft diffuse shadow onto the canvas beside it, with no hard edge
Where the sticker is peeled away the canvas shows plain background (no hole, no residue outline)
The sticker is dragged almost completely off its spot toward the bottom-right: the centre area is empty and only a large curled backing flap shows at the bottom-right of the frame
After release the sticker springs back from the half-peeled state at 3.08s to fully flat at 4.05s, in the same box as before
After settling, a small curled corner (~50 px) stays lifted at the sticker's top-left tip, showing grey backing
Grabbing the top-right tip lifts a small corner flap there with a soft shadow, while the rest of the sticker stays flat
A peel from the bottom-left drags a long curled flap out to the left, past x ~250, while the bottom-right leg stays stuck
A peel from the bottom-right rolls a flap up and over the centre, showing mirrored 'MetalForge' text on its back
While the sticker is curled, the flat part still shows the black X strokes and the white border correctly clipped along the curl line
Between these moments the sticker is fully flat and still; only a tiny curl at the top-right corner changes
The X sticker is replaced by a Google 'G' sticker in the same central box (about x 326-940, y 250-874)
The G is drawn in four flat colour segments: red top arc, yellow left, green bottom, blue crossbar and lower right, with a white die-cut border and soft shadow
The title changes from '3 Prism' to '4 Ripple' when the Ripple item is selected
The dark active pill moves from '3 Prism' to '4 Ripple' in the bottom control
Ripple: concentric ripples centred near the top of the blue crossbar bend the blue colour into lighter and darker bands, and the red arm's edge wobbles
The ripple reads as a soft refractive displacement of the picture with faint bright crests, not as drawn concentric stroked circles or hard rings
Title reads '5 Halftone' with a grey '5'
Halftone: near the cursor the blue (and nearby green) area is made of a regular grid of round dots about 12-14 px pitch, with white showing between the dots
The halftone is local: the red and yellow segments far from the cursor stay solid flat colour
The halftone dot region follows the cursor: the dotted area shifts between the two moments while the G stays put
The G sticker is peeled with the same curled 'MetalForge' backing, and by the later moment it is flat again
The hint line, header texts and bottom control stay fixed in place through the peel
The sticker face is flat matte: no gloss band or gradient across the white areas when the cursor is off it
